manifest.name: Zotero MetaFlow
manifest.description: Validate, organize and enrich reference metadata in Zotero.
manifest.author: groele

fullRun.failure: An old test selected a reset button by DOM order; it selected the newly promoted asynchronous journal-database control.

affectedRerun.includes: Correct function-addressed reset test and installation of the same retained production XPI with SHA-512 verification.

nativeFinal.scope: All full-run cases accepted with the corrected test rechecked separately; no third identical full run was counted.

settingsAudit.capture: Native before/after screenshots captured and inspected in this release run.

limits: Zotero 11 development-build evidence belongs to earlier candidates; the final 11.2.0 XPI was not rerun on Zotero 11.
No full third-party co-install matrix, screen-reader certification or long-duration large-library validation.
Commercial redistribution conditions for bundled reference datasets remain documented in the audit ledger.
